title: An anticipated reward and waiting
hook: Two stated cases: explore the assumed value of a later option at different delays.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the assumed value of a later option at different delays affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Advantage, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the assumed value of a later option at different delays in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy model values immediate 10 normally, but delayed 15 after 3 periods as Beta 1 times Delta 0.95 to the delay. What is delayed minus immediate value?
